decisions.reason: The cleaning soap gained its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits naturally into the firm's care range for its floors.
The maintenance oil complements the firm's oiled floors and costs little to carry, and the industry's growth gives enough slack to keep it without searching for other uses of the resources.
It received a page of its own in 2024, showing growing commitment, and it is closely tied to the core oiled-floor business.
The moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory sold alongside floors, and with no sign of a shortfall management has no trigger to drop it.
The high-density underlay is still listed and adds little complexity, though it may overlap with Product D and could later be consolidated with it.
An oak parquet floor sits at the heart of the established offer, and in a growing market its results are likely to meet aspirations.
